# Advisory hook requirements

The fictional OrbitNote team wants exactly two non-blocking advisory moments: `UserPromptSubmit` for substantive prompts and `SubagentStart` for a supported named role. Keep routine shell, Git, and network commands outside an advisory `PreToolUse` gate. Preserve unrelated entries in an existing `hooks.json`; preview the change and retain a backup. An unavailable or uncertain advisor should remain silent rather than deny an action. Candidate descriptions sent to an optional remote selector must exclude raw prompts, code, paths, credentials, and memory contents.
